violation_type.title: Furnishings and Equipment for Pre-Kindergarten Age - Interest Centers Used Independently (26 TAC §746.2605(1)(B))
violation_type.short_title: Furnishings and Equipment for Pre-Kindergarten Age - Interest Centers Used Independently
violation_type.typical_finding: A total of eight classroom were observed. Four out of eight classroom needs a storage bin, toys accessories and equipment and other children desk and tables.

finding_variants.text: A total of eight classroom were observed. Four out of eight classroom needs a storage bin, toys accessories and equipment and other children desk and tables.
The Pre-K classroom does not have interest centers with equipment such as blocks, toys, books for reading, etc. The room has five toys available for the children to play with.
The pre-k room was observed not having intrest areas for the children.
